Subject: Order Form tax & PO routing - Ariba activation blocker

Hi Neha,

Quick note — we hit a blocker with Ariba registration. Our finance team says Medicores' PO workflow requires a populated tax_jurisdiction and GL routing per-line; Ariba won't activate our supplier profile until the PO routing mapping is in place. The problem: the draft Order Form references Redwood's standard tax clause and requires an authorized signer on the MSA matching the Ariba onboarding identity. Our legal can't confirm the MSA redline until we know whether we can accept a delegated signer (local rep) or if we need to sign at the entity level.

Attached: MediCore_PO_Reqs.xlsx (PO field requirements). Can you confirm if Redwood can provision a temporary PO acceptance channel while we finish signature validation? We're live on procurement next month so this is time sensitive.

Thanks,
Susan Hayes
Sr. Procurement Manager
MediCore Health
attachments: MediCore_PO_Reqs.xlsx

Susan — thanks for the heads up and the attachment. Looping in Kimberly (legal) and Marissa (onboarding/ops).

Quick answers up front:
- We can gate a temporary process where we accept a signed Order Form by email for the first month while Ariba completes onboarding, but it requires legal sign-off (Kimberly) and an explicit acceptance clause in the Order Form.
- For Ariba mapping: Marissa can confirm exact field names, but we typically map tax_jurisdiction -> "taxJurisdiction" and per-line GL -> "accountCode". If MediCore needs a different field, we can add a custom mapping but it adds a 3–5 business day provisioning window.

Kimberly/Marissa — please review the attached MSA redline (we've started edits) and the PO requirements spreadsheet Susan shared. Key questions for legal: do we accept delegated signing via POA or require entity-level signer? For ops: can you confirm the mapping and whether a temporary email-acceptance path is feasible without violating PO matching (invoice vs PO)?

I'll set up a 30-min call if we need to triage in real time.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Order Form tax & PO routing - Ariba activation blocker

Neha / team — reviewed the MSA redline and MediCore PO requirements. High-level legal notes:

1) Delegated signature: we can accept a delegated signer via a notarized Power of Attorney (POA) limited to contract execution for procurement systems, provided the POA identifies the exact entity and scope. That avoids reopening the MSA for entity-level changes. We should capture this as an exception in an Order Form addendum: "Authorized Signatory Exception (limited POA)."

2) Tax clause: the Order Form must explicitly include the tax reporting jurisdiction and who bears indirect tax liability. Proposed short clause for the Order Form: "Purchaser shall provide tax jurisdiction and GL routing information for each PO; Seller (Redwood) will rely on Purchaser-provided data for tax reporting and invoice routing."

3) Temporary acceptance: legal is OK with temporary email acceptance for an initial period (30 days) if: (a) Order Form references the acceptance method; (b) MediCore confirms signer identity and POA; (c) invoices matched to POs to avoid duplicate-pay risk.

I'll attach an annotated snippet with suggested language. If the buyer wants to avoid POA, we need an executed amendment to the MSA — that will add legal turnaround time.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
attachments: MSA_redline_comments.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order Form tax & PO routing - Ariba activation blocker

Thanks — ops notes below to make this pragmatic:

1) Ariba field mapping: the supplier-side activation requires these fields populated: vendorTaxId, taxJurisdiction, remitAddress, defaultAccountCode. Per-line accountCode mapping is supported via our PO line extension; we can provision custom field mapping but it will need a short schema update and a mapping table in our Ariba connector. Time: 3 business days to schedule, 1–2 days to apply.

2) Temporary acceptance flow: we can enable a "manual-accept" status in Ariba so procurement can create a PO that still routes to the vendor profile while legal finishes sign-off. Requirements: (a) an ops ticket from MediCore requesting manual-accept; (b) a statement from MediCore confirming signer and POA attached to the first invoice; (c) contact person in their finance team (name + email).

3) PO matching: to avoid invoice rejection, advise MediCore to include Redwood's accountCode on the PO lines. If they can't populate per-line codes yet, we can accept a blanket defaultAccountCode for the first 30 days but it must be reconciled on invoice submission.

I'll prepare an internal ops checklist and share the Ariba enrollment checklist (see attached).

Marissa Cole
Onboarding Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: Ariba_enroll_checklist.pdf
